G1409.name: Drusilla
G1409.desc: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
G1409.brief: Jewish wife of Felix, the Roman governor
G1409.short: Drusilla, the Jewish wife of Felix, the Roman governor, was present when Paul spoke to Felix about faith in Christ.

G1456.name: Dedication Festival
G1456.brief: Jewish festival commemorating the rededication of the Temple
G1456.short: The Dedication_Festival, also known as Hanukkah, was a Jewish festival that commemorated the rededication of the Temple in Jerusalem (<ref="Jhn.10.22">Jhn.10.22</ref>).
